title: Livelsberger email gives Area 51 coordinates for gravitic propulsion center

tellings.quote: this very weird email sent by Matthew displays the coordinates of America gravitic propulsions Operation Center the coordinates are at Area 51

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes what he calls a very strange email sent in 2025 by a man named Matthew Livelsberger. According to Michels, the email gives the map coordinates of "America's gravitic propulsion operations center", meaning a base for craft that move by controlling gravity, and those coordinates point to Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada. If true, it would mean such a programme exists and is run from there.
